evals.prompt: I have a Figma design at https://figma.com/file/abc123 for a UserCard component. Can you implement it with pixel-perfect accuracy for mobile, tablet, and desktop?
evals.expected_output: Complete validation pipeline: extract Figma specs for all breakpoints, map to design system, generate responsive code, validate with Playwright, provide validation report.
assertions: Design specs extracted for mobile, tablet, desktop breakpoints
Design system mapping created with correct token mappings
Component code generated with responsive breakpoints
Validation report includes pass/fail for each breakpoint
Mobile-first approach applied in generated code

evals.prompt: Can you check if my Button component at src/components/Button.tsx matches the Figma design? The Figma link is https://figma.com/file/xyz789/design#button
evals.expected_output: Validation-only flow: extract Figma specs, compare to existing implementation, report differences, provide fix suggestions if needed.
assertions: Figma specs extracted from provided URL
Existing component code analyzed and styles extracted
Differences identified and reported with specific property names
Fix suggestions provided if differences found
Tolerance for sub-pixel rendering applied appropriately

evals.prompt: Update the Header component to match the new Figma design. Auto-detect the design system and handle any deviations.
evals.expected_output: Full update workflow: extract new specs, detect design system (Tailwind/Styled Components), update code, validate, handle deviations gracefully.
assertions: Code updated to match new Figma specs
